newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA, OKO RECOMMEND BUYING 2004 BOND AT AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: MERITA, OKO RECOMMEND BUYING 2004 BOND AT AUCTION.

text.p: Two Finnish banks said on Thursday it made sense for investors to participate in the state treasury's (STO) auction of the 9.50-percent S1/93 2004 benchmark bond this afternoon.
"...this bond is the cheapest on the yield curve providing a 12 bps yield pick up against the 2001 and 2006 bonds," Merita Bank said in a pre-auction comment.
"We also continue to see further flattening potential in the Finnish yield curve. We see thus no specific reason of not participating in this auction," Merita said.
OKOBANK said in its pre-auction comment that it expected STO to issue some 1.8 billion markka worth of the 2004 paper.
"We recommend spread-trade; buy 2004 and sell 1999," OKOBANK said. In the short term it could also prove a good deal to buy 2004 and sell 2006 bonds, it added.
"Despite the uncertainties on the international interest rate markets we expect moderate success fore the auction of serial bond 2004," it said.
